fusions.name: Curled Tumble
fusions.desc: Rolls over every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 14 damage and knocking each back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Launch from the Curl
fusions.desc: Springs from a curl into the first enemy in a line up to 7 tiles away, dealing 8 damage. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Seams Closed
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Sealed Ball
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield that soaks 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
